content.short: OKX provides an international cryptocurrency and derivatives exchange.
content.description: OKX, founded by Star Xu in 2017, is a Seychelles-based cryptocurrency and derivatives exchange. Users can trade over 40 assets, access an NFT market, and use a Web3 wallet alongside a suite of decentralized applications. It emphasizes core capabilities for spot and derivative trading, enabling traders to participate in a broad range of markets with flexible order types and integrated wallet and dApp access. This combination supports diverse strategies across the platform.
